outcomes.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_ad_spend
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT 
  c.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(acd.attributed_sales_14d) / NULLIF(SUM(acd.cost), 0), 2) AS roas
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND c.channel IN ('search', 'display')
GROUP BY c.channel
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(revenue_gross), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM shop_orders_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT 
  p.category,
  SUM(s.units_ordered) as total_units_ordered,
  SUM(s.units_returned) as total_units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.units_returned) / NULLIF(SUM(s.units_ordered), 0), 2) as return_rate_percent
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON s.sku = p.sku
WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY return_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  c.campaign_id,
  c.campaign_name,
  SUM(acd.clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(purchases) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0),
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE channel = 'paid search'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH display_data AS (
  SELECT
    acd.date,
    acd.clicks,
    acd.impressions
  FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
  JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel = 'display'
    AND acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(clicks) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0),
    2
  ) AS ctr_percentage
FROM display_data
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT SUM(sod.units_ordered) as total_units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily sod
JOIN products p ON sod.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.category = 'Running'
  AND sod.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_orders_14d), 0), 2) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_ad_spend
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH campaign_data AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel,
    SUM(acd.cost) AS total_cost,
    SUM(acd.attributed_sales_14d) AS total_attributed_sales
  FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
  JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel
)
SELECT
  channel,
  ROUND(total_cost, 2) AS total_cost,
  ROUND(total_attributed_sales, 2) AS total_attributed_sales,
  ROUND(total_attributed_sales / NULLIF(total_cost, 0), 2) AS roas
FROM campaign_data
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(revenue_gross) - SUM(revenue_gross * units_returned / NULLIF(units_ordered, 0)), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM shop_orders_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH category_returns AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(s.units_ordered) AS total_units_ordered,
    SUM(s.units_returned) AS total_units_returned
  FROM shop_orders_daily s
  JOIN products p ON s.sku = p.sku
  WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
  category,
  total_units_ordered,
  total_units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_units_returned / NULLIF(total_units_ordered, 0), 2) AS return_rate_percent
FROM category_returns
ORDER BY return_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT 
  c.campaign_id,
  c.campaign_name,
  SUM(a.clicks) as total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH search_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', date) AS month,
    sessions,
    purchases
  FROM web_sessions_daily
  WHERE channel = 'search'
    AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(purchases) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM search_sessions
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(c.clicks) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c.impressions), 0), 2) AS ctr_percentage
FROM ads_campaign_daily c
JOIN campaigns ca ON c.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
WHERE ca.channel = 'display'
  AND c.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  SUM(s.units_ordered) AS total_units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON s.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.category = 'Running'
  AND s.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_orders_14d), 0), 2) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost) / 100, 2) AS total_ad_spend_eur
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.channel,
       ROUND(SUM(a.attributed_sales_14d) / NULLIF(SUM(a.cost) / 100, 0), 2) AS roas
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY c.channel
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_gross) / 1.19, 2) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM shop_orders_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category,
       SUM(s.units_ordered) AS total_units_ordered,
       SUM(s.units_returned) AS total_units_returned,
       ROUND(SUM(s.units_returned) / NULLIF(SUM(s.units_ordered), 0), 4) AS return_rate
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.campaign_name,
       SUM(a.clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(purchases) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 4) AS conversion_rate
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE channel = 'paid_search'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(AVG(daily_sessions), 0) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM (
  SELECT date, SUM(sessions) AS daily_sessions
  FROM web_sessions_daily
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY date
) daily_totals
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(a.impressions), 0), 4) AS ctr
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND c.channel = 'display'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(s.units_ordered) AS units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE p.category = 'Running'
  AND s.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(a.cost) / 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.attributed_orders_14d), 0), 2) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000
